name: Elbe ferry Glückstadt–Wischhafen (FRS Elbfähre), trucks and their load
law: FRS Elbfähre's fares for trucks and cargo, valid 1 January to 31 December 2026 (the page as read on 2026-11-23, recorded): a truck, unloaded and without its driver, net of 19% VAT, by its length over all: to 5 m EUR 15.88, to 6 m EUR 18.40, to 7 m EUR 21.76, to 8 m EUR 24.79, to 9 m EUR 26.39, to 10 m EUR 27.65, to 11 m EUR 29.75, to 12 m EUR 31.01, to 13 m EUR 32.27, to 14 m EUR 34.37, to 15 m EUR 36.05, to 16 m EUR 36.89, to 17 m EUR 38.15, to 18.35 m EUR 39.41, each further metre (overhanging ones too) EUR 4.20, at most 23 m; the load by weight, EUR 1.26 per started 1,000 kg. The page's net prices up to 8, 17, 18.35 m don't match its gross ones; those are taken as gross / 1.19. The fares include the fuel surcharge (January's plus a surcharge state's net, to the cent), so it isn't added. The driver's own fare (adults "from" EUR 3.40) isn't added, nor the surcharges for over 2.50 m wide (30%) or dangerous goods, nor the frequent travellers' discounts. Ports at OpenStreetMap's ferry terminals, priced where the line goes out on its car ferry line.
